title: HTTPService
description: An HTTP service representing one or more backend servers.

name.description: The name of the service in name@provider format.

type.description: The type of service (loadBalancer, weighted, mirroring).

status.description: The current status of the service.

provider.description: The configuration provider that created this service.

loadBalancer.description: Load balancer configuration with backend servers.

url.description: The URL of the backend server.

passHostHeader.description: Whether to pass the host header to backends.

healthCheck.description: Health check configuration for the backend servers.

serverStatus.description: Map of server URLs to their current health status.
